description: Uploads a file to the media library from either a public http(s) url or base64 data (with filename + mime_type), plus optional alt text. Allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF, MP4, WebM (no SVG). Max 10 MB, or 500 MB for video. Returns the new media item including its public url. Requires the media:write scope.

alt.description: Alt text for images, max 1000 chars.

data.description: Base64-encoded file bytes (no data: prefix). Requires filename and mime_type. Provide this OR url, not both.

filename.description: File name, e.g. 'hero.png'. Required with data; optional with url.

mime_type.description: MIME type. Required with data; with url it overrides the response Content-Type. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, application/pdf, video/mp4, video/webm.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file to fetch and upload. Provide this OR data, not both.

name: upload_media
title: Upload media
